practice.foundation[6]: The booklet has no question asking students to diagnose nondifferentiability at a corner. Replace this unsupported task with a supported tangent-gradient task in the same tier.

practice.foundation[7]: The syllabus states the nonvertical-tangent condition, but no booklet question asks students to diagnose a vertical tangent. Replace this unsupported task with a supported task in the same tier; avoid calling an undefined gradient a numerical infinite gradient.

practice.mastery[0]: Finding a tangent equation and recovering the point of contact's height are not source question types for this skill. Retain the supported tangent-gradient demand through an adapted same-tier task and update its structure to describe the final task.

practice.mastery[2]: Piecewise differentiation and one-sided differentiability tests are absent from the booklet's questions and exceed this target skill. Replace this task with a supported same-tier tangent interpretation task.
